subject: Marketplace renewal & staggered billing — private offer alignment (AWS + GCP)
messages:
From: Emma Lane <emma.lane@harmonia.health>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@harmonia.health
Date: Sun, 10 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + marketplace private offer — next steps and timeline

Diego,

Hope you had a good weekend. Our renewal for the Redwood contract comes up at the end of November. Wed like to move forward with private offers in both AWS Marketplace and GCP Marketplace to standardize procurement across our cloud teams. A couple of specifics from our side:

- We want a 12-month renewal but would like staggered billing (split over 3 invoices: 40% / 30% / 30%).
- We will increase committed capacity by ~35% compared to current baseline (estimate attached).
- Procurement needs a sample PO/terms that reflect private offer IDs for both AWS and GCP so our finance team can raise a single consolidated PO.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can:
1) Present coordinated private offers in AWS and GCP tied to one commercial PO.
2) Support the staggered invoice schedule above.
3) Guarantee no service interruption during acceptance & marketplace onboarding.

If possible, wed like to close paperwork by Oct 22 to ensure billing cutover. Ive copied our procurement mailbox.

Thanks,
Emma Lane
Director, Vendor Management
Harmonia Health

Attachment: capacity_estimate_harmonia.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
To: Emma Lane <emma.lane@harmonia.health>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + marketplace private offer — next steps and timeline

Emma —

Thanks for the clear ask and the estimate. Yes, we can coordinate private offers across AWS and GCP and link them to a single commercial PO; there are a few ops steps to align billing metadata. Marissa (sales ops) and Laura (finance) are looped in to draft the PO-friendly language and the staggered invoice schedule.

Proposed immediate items:
- Marissa will prepare a redline for the amendment and a marketplace summary showing private offer IDs and pricing lines.
- Laura will confirm whether billing can be split into three invoices and provide the invoice schedule template that Finance needs.
- Internal ops (Jonas) will confirm any acceptance window constraints for the two marketplaces so we dont trigger interruption during cutover.

Target: paperwork out to you by EOD Oct 14, final sign by Oct 22 to hit your cutover. If that timeline looks tight, flag which date we should shift to.

Ill also attach a draft PO template so procurement can start their side.

--
Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_PO_template.docx (attachment stub)

Subject: RE: Renewal + marketplace private offer — draft amendment and PO language

Emma / team,

Thanks — attaching a concise summary and a draft amendment that we think meets your requirements. Highlights:
- 12-month term starting on the effective date you sign; private offers will be created in AWS and GCP with matching pricing lines and linked to the master PO number.
- Staggered invoicing: we can generate invoices at t0 (40%), t0+120 days (30%), t0+240 days (30%). Finance will include billing metadata fields for the marketplace invoice reconciliation.
- Capacity uplift: weve provisionally reserved additional pool capacity to cover ~35% uplift; this will be finalized after you confirm expected monthly token distribution.
- Acceptance window: AWS private offers require a 30-day acceptance window; GCP can support up to 90 days. Our ops recommendation is to accept AWS first and then GCP within 45 days to avoid double-cutover risk.

Attached: marketplace_private_offer_summary.xlsx (summary of marketplace SKUs & private offer IDs), Harmonia_PO_draft_v3.pdf (redline), capacity_plan_v2.xlsx (capacity uplift proposal).

Next steps:
1) Emma/procurement to confirm stagger percentage and PO master ID.
2) Laura to confirm final invoice sequence and PO fields for your AP system.
3) Jonas to schedule a 30-min ops handshake with your cloud team to review acceptance order and cutover times (I suggest Wed Oct 20).

If youre comfortable, we can issue DocuSign envelopes for the amendment and PO the same day you confirm the PO ID.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Commercial Ops, Redwood Inference

Marissa / Diego —

Thanks for the quick turn. Procurement has reviewed the draft and we can proceed with the proposed staggered schedule but with two edits:

1) Acceptance window: we need a 60-day free acceptance period across the combined private offers (Harmonia has an external audit in early Dec and we want to avoid any forced renewal acceptance during that period).
2) Invoice dates: wed like the second invoice at t0+90 days instead of 120 to align with our quarter closing.

PO master ID: HH-PO-2027-1109 (this will be the number on the commercial PO). We will send the signed PO as soon as DocuSign routes it to us.

One more ask: can you include an itemized usage uplift cap page so our finance/engineering teams understand how burst capacity will be billed if we exceed the 35% uplift?

Ive attached our internal payment terms (Net45) so finance can reconcile.

Emma Lane
Director, Vendor Management
Harmonia Health
